subject: physics
title: Energy Stores & Transfers - Application
welcome_lead: Trace energy through real machines and devices.
meta_desc: KS3 Physics: applying stores and transfers to everyday machines.
final_note: You can trace energy through any device now - awesome!

concepts.def: Where energy is held until transferred — like kinetic, gravitational, chemical, thermal.
Energy in a moving object; faster and heavier objects have more.
Energy in an object held high up; bigger if mass or height is bigger.
Energy in food, fuel and batteries; released by reactions.
Energy in hotter objects; transferred when in contact with cooler ones.
Energy can't be made or destroyed, only transferred from store to store.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Every machine has useful energy output (what we want) and wasted energy (often heat or sound).

A lamp: useful = light, wasted = heat.
A car engine: useful = motion, wasted = heat + sound.
A kettle: useful = heating water, wasted = sound + heat to room.

Wasted energy is dissipated - it spreads out and is hard to use again.

A pendulum is a great energy demo.

At the top: lots of gravitational, no kinetic.
At the bottom: lots of kinetic, no gravitational.
Halfway: a mix of both.

Energy swaps from gravitational to kinetic and back, transferred mechanically.

A roller coaster shows everything:

1. Motor lifts cart (electrical -> gravitational).
2. Cart drops (gravitational -> kinetic).
3. Friction with rails (kinetic -> thermal + sound).
4. Brakes at the end (kinetic -> thermal).

Total energy stays the same overall - just keeps changing form.
